description: This file contains functions for discovering Open Home Cameras using SSDP, including starting and stopping discovery, and handling discovered devices.

methods.name: ohcmDiscoverStop
methods.description: Stops the SSDP camera discovery process and frees associated resources.

methods.name: discoverCallback
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when an SSDP device is discovered; calls the user-provided callback with device info.

methods.name: ohcmDiscoverStart
methods.description: Starts the SSDP camera discovery process, registers callback, and returns a status code.
